Observed-mid contribution uses actual fill-time mid for passive buys, next-open mid for IOC buys, and actual sell-observation mids. It includes selected fills, holding periods and protective exits; it is not isolated entry alpha.
Attribution holds actual sold shares, ownership and execution paths fixed. Removing costs would change fills, sizing, ownership and latches; this is not a tradable cost-free counterfactual.
Retained BTC is marked, not sold. Sold-share fee allocation is not the entire buy fee paid, and pooled account dollars are not a funded portfolio.
Synthetic candle paths and prior-minute participation do not establish historical OKX queues, fill probabilities, books, fees or instrument rules.
Subgroup results are descriptive development diagnostics, not significance tests or causal strategy improvements.
